title: Steelers prepare for first full-pads practice of post-Mike Tomlin era

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers prepare for first full-pads practice of post-Mike Tomlin era
sources.description: After 19 years of hard-hitting, tackling-to-the-ground training-camp practices under Mike Tomlin, the Steelers will put on pads for the first time in 20 years without Tomlin running the show.
